title: TWO DOWN IN 18 MINUTES. UNITED STILL WON 3-2.
description:
Three minutes, two goals, and a United win nobody saw coming.

Roma came in unbeaten in Serie A and led 2-0 after eighteen minutes. Then their defence took a day trip.

A poor Balerdi clearance led to the equaliser. Matheus Cunha scored in the 83rd and 86th minutes. Bruno Fernandes had just accepted being benched, and his penalty was saved, then retaken, then scored. Persistence. Or paperwork.

The win ended a nine-match winless run. Cunha then saw a second yellow in stoppage time. Hero and early bath, in one evening.

Who was United's man of the night: Cunha or Fernandes? Tell us why.
